paite: Noplen ka hi kei a hia? Sawltak kei a hia? I Toupa Jesu ka muta kei a hia? Noute Toupa a ka nasep gah na hi kei ua hia?
heading: Sawltakte Thuneih Leh Hamphatna

paite: Midangte a ding in sawltak hi kei mah leng, noute a ding bek in zaw ka hi; Toupa a ka sawltak hihna chiamtehna noumau na hi uhi.
Hiai kei hon demte ka dawn na ahi,
Ne ding leh dawn ding in thu ka nei kei ua hia?
Sawltak dangte leh Toupa unaute leh Kifas bang in zi gingtami pi vialvial ding in thu ka nei kei ua hia?
Ahihkeileh kei leh Barnabas kia koumau kivak kawm a khut a nna sem lou ding in thu ka nei lou tuam ua hia?
Sepaih kua ahia amah kivak a galkap ngei? Kua'n ahia agah ne lou a grephuan bawl ngei? Ahihkeileh kua'n ahia ganhon nawitui ne lou a ganhon vul ngei?
Huai thute mihing bang mai in ka gen a hia? Dan thu mah in leng huai ngei agen sam kei a hia?
Mosi Dan Laibu ah, "Bawngtal in buh achil lai in amuk gak ke'n," chih gelh ahi. Pathian in bawngtal a ding kia hia angaihtuahsak?
Ahihkeileh ei a ding a kigen ahi hia? Hi e, ei a ding a agelh ahi; lei letpa'n lamet nei a aleh ding ahi a, buhvopa'n leng tan neih sam lamen a avuak ding ahi.
Koute'n khalam thilte na kiang ua ka tuh ngal uleh, na salam thilte uh at le ung leng thil thupi ahi dia hia?
Midang in bawn na tung ua thuneihna atan uleh kou tang sem lou ding ka hi uh maw? Himahleh huai thuneihna ka zang kei uh; Khrist tanchinhoih ka dallouhna ding un bangkim ka thuak teitei uhi.
Tempul a thil siangthou bawl vialvialte'n tempul a kipan nek amu ua, maitam a nasemte'n maitam a pan ane uh chih na thei kei ua hia?
Huchi mah bang in, Toupa'n tanchinhoih gente nek muhna ding in tanchinhoih mah asep hi.

Himahleh ke'n zaw tuate khat leng ka zang kei hi; ka tung a hiaite na hih ding uh ahi chi a hiai thu gelh ka hi kei hi. Kuapeuh in ka suan pen bangmah lou a abawl sang un, si mai leng kei a ding in ahoihzaw hi.
Tanchinhoih gen mah leng kisaktheihna ding ahi kei hi. Hih louh theih louh ka tung ah akinga ahi; tanchinhoih gen kei leng ka tung gik ding ahi.
Huai tuh keimah ut thu a hih hi leng kipahman ka nei hi; himahleh, keimah ut thu ahihkeileh tanchinhoih kepna nna piak a om ka hi.
Ka kipahman bang ahia le? Tanchinhoih ka gen in loh nei lou a, tanchinhoih athawn a pia ka hihtheihna ahi.
Mi teng a pan zalen himah leng, mi tamsem ka laktheihna ding in mi tengteng sikha in ka kibawlta hi.
heading: Khrist Sikha A Kipiakna

paite: Huchi in Judate ka laklut theihna ding in Judate kiang ah Juda mi bang in ka om zel; dan nuai a omte ka laklut theihna ding in dan nuai a omte kiang ah dan nuai a om bang in ka om zel; dan nuai a om tuan lou in.
Dan neiloute ka laklut theihna ding in dan neiloute kiang ah dan nei lou bang in ka om zel, Pathian dan a om lou tuan lou in; Khrist dan zom ngal in.
Hatloute ka laklut theihna ding in hatloute kiang ah hat lou bang in ka om zel; hihtheihna teng zang a khenkhatte ka hotdam theihna ding in mi tengteng kiang ah bangkim ka hita hi.
Tanchinhoih ziak in bangkim ka hih zel a, huai nasepna a ka tel sam theihna ding in.
Kitaitehte avek un atai ua, himahleh khat kia in kipahman amu zel chih na thei kei ua hia? Na muhtheihna ding un huchi mah bang in tai un.
heading: Vualzou Ding A Kisukna

paite: Huan kidemna a kimawl mi peuhmah bangkim ah mahni kithunun in a-om nak hi. Amau zaw lallukhu se thei mu ding in ahih ua, eite'n bel Lallukhu Setheilou mu ding in.
Huaiziak in kei ka tai a, aziak bei hilou in; huihkhua leltak noh lou in ka pang hi.
Himahleh ka pumpi ka thunun a; sikha in ka bawl zaw zel hi; huchi lou in zaw midangte kiang a ka tangkoupih nung in leng bangchi hiam in kei ngeitak kipahman mu tak lou in ka om kha ding hi.
